application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Türkiye Bursları Application System (TBBS)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the TBBS online portal using valid email address and Pakistani passport/CNIC during the single annual application window (January 10 - February 20).
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on TBBS portal (opens January 10).
2. Fill profile: Personal Info, Education Info, Language Info, Work Experience, Social Activities.
3. Select up to 12 university and program preferences.
4. Write Statement of Purpose and Research Proposal (for Master's/PhD).
5. Upload academic transcripts, certificates, passport, and extracurricular awards.
6. Submit online application before February 20 deadline.
7. Preliminary expert review of dossiers (March - April).
8. Shortlisted candidates invited for in-person panel interview in Islamabad, Lahore, or Karachi (May - June).
9. Final selection results announced on TBBS portal (late July - early August).
10. Sign Scholarship Agreement, obtain Turkish Student Visa, receive free flight ticket (August).
11. Depart for Turkey (mid-September).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated 1-step routing: YTB places selected scholars directly into their approved university programs.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate on the TBBS portal (scanned letters on university/company letterhead).
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Letter of Intent (integrated into TBBS): Explain academic background, reason for choosing Turkey, and career expectations.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD/Master's applicants must formulate a structured research proposal: Title, Problem Statement, Literature Review, Methodology, and Significance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Generated automatically through TBBS profile sections.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous 20-30 minute in-person interview in Islamabad, Lahore, or Karachi conducted by Turkish academic professors and YTB delegates (evaluates academic knowledge, motivation, and mathematical aptitude).
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: Not required by YTB; SAT/GRE scores provide strong competitive advantage for English-taught engineering programs.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MOFA attestation of degree certificates required after award confirmation for university registration.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Turkish or English translations of all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online portal submission on TBBS.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam education consultants in Pakistan charging PKR 50,000 to 200,000 claiming 'direct quota arrangements with the Turkish government'. All applications must be submitted personally on TBBS.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Türkiye Bursları is 100% FREE. Never pay any application fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Applications submitted through intermediaries are frequently disqualified.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Equivalence Certificate (Denklik Belgesi) processing fee from the Turkish Ministry of National Education (MEB) or Turkish Embassy (approx PKR 10,000 to 20,000).
HEC, IBCC, and MOFA degree attestation costs in Pakistan.
Living cost inflation: The monthly stipend (TRY 3,500 to 6,500) covers basic personal spending, but scholars in Istanbul/Ankara often benefit from modest family pocket money support (~$50-100/mo).
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You cannot study in English. (Fact: Hundreds of programs at top Turkish universities are taught in English; however, learning basic Turkish is mandatory for daily life and cultural integration).
MYTH: You must return to Pakistan immediately. (Fact: Turkey allows international graduates to apply for post-study residence permits and work legally in the Turkish economy).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some consultants tell medical applicants that 70% is enough; official YTB regulations strictly enforce a 90% minimum cutoff for Medicine, Dentistry, and Pharmacy.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum GPA specified by Turkish university regulations (typically 2.00/4.00 for Undergrad, 2.50/4.00 for Master's, 3.00/4.00 for PhD).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time attendance. Unexcused absence results in warning and stipend deduction.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Universities submit termly academic transcript reports to YTB.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Undergraduate students can work legally up to 24 hours/week after completing their first year; Master's and PhD students can work part-time with formal work permits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars sign an agreement promising to return to their home countries upon graduation to foster bilateral relations, though no coercive financial bond is imposed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholars dismissed for disciplinary violations or voluntary dropout without valid reason may be required to repay travel and allowance costs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing university is strictly prohibited except under exceptional administrative transfers approved by YTB.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum 1 year extension can be granted for thesis completion without monthly stipend (dormitory and tuition remain covered).

visa_fee.details: Abu Dhabi University sponsors UAE Student Residence Visa; student pays government visa medical and Emirates ID processing fee (~AED 2,500; ~PKR 190,000).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: E-textbooks and software licenses are provided via university portal; physical books are self-funded.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Abu Dhabi University Online Admissions & Scholarship Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the ADU online admissions portal, fill out student bio-data, select degree program and campus, and check the box to apply for Academic / Chairman Scholarship.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (May - June): Prepare educational credentials; obtain IBCC equivalence certificate (for Pakistani Intermediate/Matric) and MOFA attestation.
Step 2 (June - July): Register on ADU Online Admissions Portal (adu.ac.ae/apply-now) and complete the admission form.
Step 3 (July): Upload certified transcripts, passport copy, Emirates ID (if UAE resident), English test certificate (IELTS/EmSAT), and passport photographs.
Step 4 (Late July / Early August): Admissions committee assesses application and high school marks; conditional admission and scholarship tier offer issued within 5-7 business days.
Step 5 (August): Complete UAE Ministry of Education (MOE) certificate equivalency via the online MOE portal.
Step 6 (Mid-August): Pay initial deposit to secure seat (adjusted against registration/visa); receive unconditional admission letter and scholarship contract.
Step 7 (Late August): University issues UAE Student Visa sponsorship entry permit; travel to Abu Dhabi or Dubai.
Step 8 (Early September): Complete medical examination in UAE, obtain Emirates ID, attend campus orientation, and enroll in classes.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated application: Scholarship assessment occurs automatically based on submitted high school or university grades.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: One to two recommendation letters from high school principal or university professors uploaded directly to online portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal Statement (500 words): Discuss academic interests, career ambitions in the UAE and internationally, and reason for choosing Abu Dhabi University.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for undergraduate applicants. For Master's applicants: 1-2 page statement of research or professional objectives.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV outlining educational history, academic honors, extracurriculars, and technical skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No formal interview required; selection is strictly based on standardized high school / university marks and English test compliance.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: EmSAT English (1400+) or IELTS Academic (6.0+) or TOEFL iBT (79+). EmSAT Math score or ADU math placement test required for engineering.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: AED 315 (Waived for Chairman Scholarship recipients upon final enrollment)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan, followed by UAE Embassy in Islamabad or UAE Consulate in Karachi.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Arabic translations for any documents not originally issued in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via Abu Dhabi University admissions portal.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Study in Saudi Portal & KFU Deanship of Admissions
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the 'Study in Saudi' system, choose 'External Scholarship', specify King Faisal University, select degree program, and upload color document scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check application window on studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa (typically opens September/October).
Step 2: Complete profile registration, enter educational qualifications and percentages.
Step 3: Upload color scans of passport, educational certificates, transcripts, police report, and medical clearance.
Step 4: Select King Faisal University and arrange desired programs in order of preference.
Step 5: Submit application online without application fee and retain application tracking reference.
Step 6: KFU admissions board screens applications and submits candidate nominations to the Ministry of Education (December - March).
Step 7: Final approvals granted by Saudi Ministry of Education and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (May - July).
Step 8: Admission confirmation and visa authorization issued on the portal.
Step 9: Complete visa processing at Gerry's / Etimad in Pakistan, obtain university-booked flight ticket, and travel to Saudi Arabia in September.

step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Get matric/intermediate/degrees attested by IBCC/HEC and MoFA Pakistan.

Step 9: Complete medical screening at GAMCA-approved medical center in Pakistan, submit passport to Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi for Student Visa stamping.
Step 10: University issues complimentary electronic flight ticket; arrive at Abha/Bisha Airport for university reception and hostel check-in.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Saudi Ministry of Education Unified 'Study in Saudi' (Minhati) Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the Saudi Ministry of Education portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa), select University of Hafr Al Batin, choose desired computing major, and upload required attested documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Attest Matric and Intermediate (or Bachelor's) certificates and marksheets from IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan; obtain certified Arabic translations.
Step 2: Obtain Police Character Clearance Certificate from Police Khidmat Markaz and get it attested by MOFA Pakistan.
Step 3: Register on the 'Study in Saudi' portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa) between September and November.
Step 4: Select University of Hafr Al Batin and specify preferred programs in the College of Computer Science and Engineering.
Step 5: Upload passport scan, attested academic credentials, medical certificate, police report, and letters of recommendation.
Step 6: UHB Deanship of Admissions screens applications and ranks candidates under the Pakistan country quota (25 seats).
Step 7: Selected candidate dossier forwarded to Saudi Ministry of Education and Ministry of Foreign Affairs for security and administrative clearance (April - June).
Step 8: Final scholarship approval issued; Saudi MOE issues electronic visa authorization slip.
Step 9: Complete GCC/GAMCA medical examination in Pakistan, submit passport to Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi for visa stamping.
Step 10: University issues complimentary flight ticket; arrive at Dammam/Qaisumah Airport for university welcome and dormitory allocation.

application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for undergraduate applicants; Master's applicants provide a 2 to 3-page research proposal in computer science or software engineering.

application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the unified Study in Saudi portal.

university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: NYUAD is one of the most selective undergraduate institutions on earth (acceptance rate ~3-4%); shortlisted finalists are flown all-expenses-paid to Abu Dhabi for the renowned 'Candidate Weekend' before final admission offers are rendered.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus heavily on unique intellectual curiosity and global citizenship in the Common App essays. If NYUAD is your unequivocal first choice, applying Early Decision (ED1 or ED2) significantly maximizes admission probability.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: The Common Application & College Board CSS Profile
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create account on Common App, add New York University, select Abu Dhabi campus as primary campus of interest, and complete the CSS Profile on cssprofile.collegeboard.org.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Complete Common Application profile, activities list, personal essay, and NYU-specific essay prompts (August - October).
Step 2: Submit official secondary school transcripts (Grades 9-11 and Grade 12 first-term / predicted grades) via school counselor.
Step 3: Have academic teachers submit two detailed recommendation letters.
Step 4: Complete and submit the CSS Profile for financial aid, uploading parent income tax returns and salary certificates to IDOC.
Step 5: Submit application by deadline: Early Decision 1 (Nov 1), Early Decision 2 (Jan 1), or Regular Decision (Jan 5).
Step 6: Selected semifinalists receive invitations to NYUAD 'Candidate Weekend' (all-expenses-paid visit to Abu Dhabi or virtual immersive experience).
Step 7: Admissions committee renders final admission and comprehensive fellowship package (mid-December for ED1, mid-February for ED2, late March for RD).
Step 8: Sign enrollment agreement, submit visa documentation to NYUAD Student Mobility Office.
Step 9: Arrive in Abu Dhabi in late August for the international student orientation program (Marhaba Week).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Admission automatically qualifies students for 100% need-met financial aid via the CSS Profile.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by school counselor and teachers directly through Common Application portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Common App personal statement (650 words) plus NYU supplemental essay exploring why NYU's global network and Abu Dhabi campus uniquely resonate with applicant's intellectual ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for undergraduates; evaluated on academic passion and extracurricular depth.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Embedded Common App activities sheet (up to 10 activities with detailed descriptions of impact and hours).
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Extensive interviews and collaborative group activities conducted during the exclusive NYUAD 'Candidate Weekend' by faculty and admissions deans.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: Test-Optional (SAT/ACT not mandatory; competitive applicants submitting scores typically present SAT 1480-1560 or ACT 33-35).
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: USD 80 (Fee waiver available via Common App for financial hardship)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Final high school diploma and transcripts must be authenticated by IBCC/British Council, MoFA Pakistan, and the UAE Embassy in Islamabad upon enrollment.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for any documents not in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online submission via Common App and CSS Profile.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Doha Institute Online Admissions & Scholarship Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the DI Admissions Portal, select desired Master's program, complete the application forms, and indicate scholarship consideration (Tamim or Sanad).
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Create online profile on the Doha Institute admissions portal (September - October).
Step 2: Fill in personal information, undergraduate academic qualifications, and upload required documents.
Step 3: Submit academic writing sample, statement of purpose, and nominate two academic referees.
Step 4: Submit application before the deadline (typically January 15; no application fee required).
Step 5: Referees submit letters of evaluation via automated institutional links.
Step 6: Academic admissions committee conducts initial file screening and releases interview invitations (February - March).
Step 7: Selected candidates participate in online video interviews conducted by faculty panels (March - April).
Step 8: Final admission and scholarship award decisions published (May).
Step 9: Accept the scholarship offer, receive Qatari student visa and e-ticket, and arrive in Doha in August.

application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated links dispatched directly to their institutional email addresses.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Interest detailing academic background, intellectual motivations for pursuing graduate studies at DI, and how the program aligns with career ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Academic writing sample (an undergraduate thesis chapter, published paper, or analytical research paper) demonstrating critical thinking and research methodology.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Curriculum vitae detailing education, research papers, conferences, internships, and languages.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous 20 to 30-minute online interview conducted by a panel of 2-3 faculty members evaluating analytical depth, research interests, and communication skills.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None strictly required (GRE optional); English proficiency test or MOI letter required for English-track programs.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Bachelor's degree and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan, MoFA, and the Embassy of Qatar in Islamabad upon final admission.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on apply.aus.edu, select the graduate degree program, check the box for Graduate Assistantship (GTA/GRA), and upload all academic documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check application deadlines on apply.aus.edu (Priority Fall deadline: March 15 / Final: June 15).
Step 2: Take IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL (min 80) and request official score submission.
Step 3: Create account on the AUS application portal, complete personal details, and upload degree certificates and transcripts.
Step 4: Indicate application for Graduate Assistantship (Teaching or Research).
Step 5: Pay the application fee of AED 450 online via credit card.
Step 6: Nominate two academic referees who will submit letters via automated email links.
Step 7: Departmental Graduate Committee reviews applications and conducts video interviews (April - May).
Step 8: Final admission and assistantship offer letters dispatched (May - June).
Step 9: Complete UAE visa processing, accept assistantship contract, and arrive in Sharjah in August.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: King Saud University International Admissions Portal (SIAdmission) & Study in Saudi Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the KSU International Student Admissions portal (siadmission.ksu.edu.sa), fill the electronic application form, select academic degree program, and upload all required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Attest academic certificates and transcripts from IBCC/HEC and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan; obtain certified Arabic translations.
Step 2: Obtain Police Character Clearance Certificate from Police Khidmat Markaz and get it attested by MOFA Pakistan.
Step 3: Take IELTS Academic (minimum 6.0) or TOEFL iBT (minimum 75) test and obtain official scorecard.
Step 4: Register on the KSU International Admissions portal (siadmission.ksu.edu.sa) during the November to January intake window.
Step 5: Fill in personal and academic information, select major (College of Computer and Information Sciences / Engineering), and upload high-resolution document scans.
Step 6: KSU Departmental Admissions Committees conduct academic and research reviews and rank applicants by competitive merit.
Step 7: Shortlisted applicants undergo security clearance by the Saudi Ministry of Education and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (April - June).
Step 8: Final scholarship award notification issued; Saudi MOE issues electronic visa slip.
Step 9: Complete medical screening at GAMCA-approved center in Pakistan, submit passport to Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi for Student Visa stamping.
Step 10: University issues complimentary round-trip flight ticket; arrive at King Khalid International Airport (Riyadh) for university reception and student housing check-in.

application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose outlining academic background, intellectual interests, career ambitions, and motivation for studying at King Saud University.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Master's and PhD applicants must submit a 3 to 5-page research proposal outlining the intended thesis focus, literature review, and proposed methodology.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic curriculum vitae listing educational history, publications, honors, research experience, and technical competencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Generally no interview conducted; selection is based on comprehensive document evaluation and academic credentials (departments may occasionally conduct online interviews for PhD candidates).

application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan, followed by Saudi Cultural Mission and Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia upon final selection.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified Arabic translation for all English/Urdu educational documents and police clearance certificate.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via King Saud University SIAdmission portal.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: AUB Mastercard Foundation Online Scholarship & Admissions Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Register on the AUB Graduate Admissions portal and the MCF Scholars application system. Step 2: Fill out the comprehensive financial need assessment and family socioeconomic questionnaire. Step 3: Upload transcripts, degree certificates, CV, English scorecards, and leadership essays before March 15.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review eligible master's degree programs and MCF selection criteria on aub.edu.lb/mcf.
Step 2: Submit an online application for graduate admission to AUB.
Step 3: Complete the dedicated Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program application questionnaire.
Step 4: Complete the detailed household income, financial need, and asset disclosure section.
Step 5: Write and upload leadership and give-back essays detailing community impact in Pakistan.
Step 6: Register two referees (one academic and one community/civic leadership referee).
Step 7: Submit the complete dossier before the deadline (March 15).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: GUST Graduate Admissions & Financial Aid Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the GUST Online Admissions Portal (gust.edu.kw/admissions), select Master of Science in Computer Science, select 'Graduate Assistantship / Fellowship Application', upload transcripts and credentials, and pay the KWD 30 application fee before May 15.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check admission guidelines and faculty research profiles on the GUST Graduate Studies & Research portal (gust.edu.kw/graduate_studies).
Step 2: Prepare HEC/MoFA-attested Bachelor degree, official transcripts, IELTS/TOEFL scorecard, and CV.
Step 3: Register an account on GUST Online Admissions Portal.
Step 4: Complete the graduate application form and check the Graduate Assistantship / Fellowship consideration box.
Step 5: Upload required academic documents, personal statement, and portfolio of technical projects.
Step 6: Pay the KWD 30 application fee online via credit card.
Step 7: Provide contact details for two academic referees who will submit letters directly.
Step 8: Attend an online technical and motivation interview with the Department of Computer Science Graduate Committee in June.
Step 9: Receive admission and assistantship award letter in July; GUST coordinates visa sponsorship and onboarding.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: Students apply for graduate program admission and indicate interest in the Graduate Assistantship / Fellowship within the single institutional portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted electronically by academic professors via referee links sent by the GUST Admissions Office.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (max 750 words) describing academic accomplishments, technical projects, interest in GUST graduate research, and motivation for graduate assistantship duties.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Preliminary research statement (1-2 pages) describing intended master's thesis topic in AI, cybersecurity, or data systems.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard professional academic CV highlighting programming languages, open-source repositories, projects, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual interview via Zoom/Teams with graduate program director focusing on programming skills, teaching readiness, and research interests.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ or TOEFL iBT 80+; GRE General Test optional but strongly recommended for funding competition.

application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via GUST Graduate Admissions Portal.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Visit kapsarc.org/careers/visiting-fellowships/, create an applicant profile, select 'Visiting Doctoral Fellowship', upload detailed research proposal, writing sample, transcripts, CV, and letters of recommendation before March 1.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review KAPSARC research themes, active projects, and fellow profiles at kapsarc.org.
Step 2: Draft a comprehensive 5 to 10-page research proposal detailing research objectives, methodology (econometric or optimization), data sources, and policy implications.
Step 3: Prepare academic transcripts, proof of PhD enrollment / candidacy, writing sample (published paper or dissertation chapter), and English test score.
Step 4: Submit the complete application package through KAPSARC Careers / Visiting Fellowships online portal by March 1.
Step 5: KAPSARC Research Directors and Senior Fellows review proposals and evaluate methodological rigor and policy relevance.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates are invited for a virtual seminar presentation (research seminar + interview) with the KAPSARC research panel in April.
Step 7: Final fellowship award decisions announced in May.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: KFUPM Deanship of Graduate Studies Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the KFUPM graduate admissions portal during the open application cycles (Fall intake: January - February; Spring intake: September - October).
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on KFUPM online graduate portal during open window.
2. Fill academic history, upload bachelor's/master's transcripts and degree certificates.
3. Upload valid IELTS (min 6.0) or TOEFL (min 68) test score certificate.
4. Upload GRE General score card (if available; highly recommended).
5. Write Statement of Purpose outlining research interests in engineering/science.
6. Register 3 academic referees who submit online recommendation forms directly.
7. Pay nominal application fee (SAR 100) and submit online application.
8. Departmental graduate committees evaluate files (March - April).
9. Official admission and scholarship award letters issued via portal (May/June).
10. Attest educational documents via HEC, MOFA, and Saudi Cultural Mission (SACM) in Islamabad.
11. Receive Saudi Student Visa authorization and book prepaid flight to Dammam (August).
12. Arrive at KFUPM campus in Dhahran for orientation.
